description: This file defines a PHP class 'Home' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Common' namespace. The class extends a base controller and implements a method 'index()' that sets up the page's meta tags and loads various common layout components (header, footer, side columns, content areas) for the home page of an OpenCart storefront.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Controller class for the home page, responsible for setting page metadata and assembling layout components.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that initializes the page title, description, keywords, loads layout components, and renders the view for the home page.
